Class Rental

java.lang.Object
common.Rental
public class Rental extends Object
Represents one customer's rental of one vehicle for a set number of days. The rental keeps references to the existing Vehicle and Renter objects instead of copying their data.

  • Constructor Details

    • Rental

      public Rental(Vehicle rentedVehicle, Renter customer, int rentalDuration)
      Creates an active rental after checking its required values.
      Parameters:
      rentedVehicle - the vehicle being rented
      customer - the customer renting the vehicle
      rentalDuration - the number of rental days; must be positive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required object is null or duration is not positive

      public double getTotalCharge()
      Calculates this rental's charge using the vehicle's overridden rate method. This is an example of runtime polymorphism: the actual vehicle type chooses which pricing implementation runs.
      Returns:
      the total charge for the rental duration
